proposed_comments.title: Make profile-resource integration tests hermetic

confidence.rationale: The integration tests write the real Keyboard Manager settings files and use the production synchronization event, so another local Keyboard Manager instance or concurrent test run can consume the event, retain remappings, or prevent cleanup.

proposed_comments.body:
### Make profile-resource integration tests hermetic

**Severity:** `high`

The profile-resource integration tests currently operate on the user's real Keyboard Manager settings directory and the production synchronization event. That makes the test outcome dependent on the local user's settings and on other processes, and cleanup can restore the files without reloading the restored state, leaving test remappings active. Run the tests against an isolated settings root and test-only synchronization primitive, or otherwise fully virtualize those dependencies, and ensure cleanup reloads the restored state before the suite exits.
